correctness.rationale: In the cubic graph the selected-neighbor threshold is 1 plus the membership bit. On the n two-vertex columns, ordinary transitions enforce this test at the middle column, and the closing edge swaps rows. A labelled assignment corresponds to exactly one term of the twisted trace with a fixed starting column; this also works for n=2, whose three neighbors are distinct. Independently verified the determinant and the adjugate-trace numerator at 33 distinct integer weights: each coefficient has degree at most 32, so these are exact polynomial identities, not a finite-width extrapolation. The two low excess series simplify as stated, giving four size-n sets when 4 divides n, and 2n or 3n size-(n+1) sets in the other even or odd cases. Direct vertex enumeration agrees for widths 2 through 8. The width-zero and width-one terms are formal traces only.
residual_risks: The result counts labelled sets, not graph automorphism orbits.

evidence: Both indexed descriptions concern 1-limited domination in Möbius ladders, including the 4, 2n, 3n minimum counts. The explicit selected-vertex condition is important: cubic (1,2)-domination and global strong defensive alliances have the relevant one-outside/two-inside thresholds, unlike domination defined by a [1,2] cap on outside vertices.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The decisive hits use the same object and invariant, rather than a similarly named but different restriction; they do not require an alias-based identification.

originality.rationale: Two distinct earlier indexed Resultary records jointly provide strong specific evidence of coverage: both report the same ladder distribution and minimum census, and the October 26 record explicitly reports the rational enumeration for every cardinality. On the stated cubic Möbius ladder and selected-vertex predicate, the all-cardinality counts determine the same polynomial sequence. A different transfer representation or the addition of width-zero/one artificial trace terms would not make that census a new claim. This is a scientific rejection on the available positive coverage evidence, not a claim that the exact numerator and denominator were compared from primary full texts.
residual_risks: The two earlier Results were not readable in full; the judgment credits their precise indexed claim descriptions but does not certify their proofs or establish an identical N/D presentation.
No negative whole-paper conclusion is drawn from missing primary literature passages.
